label: Software Team
blurb: A Product Director with product, engineering, testing, security and design
purpose: For a business building an app or software product. The Product Director owns the roadmap; the team writes specs, builds, tests, reviews security and designs the screens.

project.name: Product
project.goal: Ship the most valuable improvements every two weeks, tested and safe.

members.title: Product Director
members.name: Alicia
focus: Own the roadmap and the two-week plan.

members.title: Product Manager
members.name: Ibrahim
focus: Write a clear spec for each item in the plan.

members.title: Software Engineer
members.name: Kai
focus: Build the specs in small, reviewed changes.

members.title: QA Tester
members.name: Nina
focus: Test every change before it ships.

members.title: Security Reviewer
members.name: Rafael
focus: Review every change that touches sign-in, payments or personal data.

members.title: Product Designer
members.name: Yara
focus: Design the screens for each spec.
